title: alerts dont blame name next step
rule: Don’t blame the user; name the next step. Polite; include how to recover. Educational material is allowed because people will read an error that unblocks them. Don’t notify off the current goal. Destructive work → confirmation modal, not an alert.
pass_when: Copy is polite, names recovery, stays on the current goal; destructive actions use a confirmation modal.
fail_when: Blame-the-user copy; no next step; alert used instead of a destructive confirmation; notification unrelated to the current goal.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
